label: Objection: the tertia via's step from 'each thing that can not-be at some time is not' to 'if all…
paraphrase: Objection: the tertia via's step from 'each thing that can not-be at some time is not' to 'if all can not-be, at some time nothing was' is a quantifier-shift fallacy; a perpetual relay of overlapping contingent beings satisfies the premises with something at every time.
